about.title: About Dr. Akshata
about.bio: Dr. Akshata Bhand is a veterinary physician based in Nandgaon, Nashik. She currently serves as Livestock Development Officer (Class I Government Officer) at Nandgaon, and is also pursuing her PhD at the Indian Veterinary Research Institute (IVRI), Division of Medicine, with a focus on veterinary cardiology. Her clinical work covers companion animals — particularly dogs and cats — as well as cattle, goats, and other livestock. She has published research in areas including cardiac disease in dogs, tick-borne infections, blood disorders, and livestock health. She also provides farmer education and is involved in artificial insemination and livestock breeding support.

dogs.q: Do you treat dogs and cats?
dogs.a: Yes. Dogs and cats are a major part of the practice. This includes routine check-ups, vaccination, internal medicine, cardiac evaluation, and follow-up care.

homeVisit.q: Can you visit our home or farm?
homeVisit.a: Home visits and farm visits are available in the Nandgaon and Nashik area. Please contact Dr. Akshata directly to discuss and schedule.

emergency.q: What should I do in an emergency?
emergency.a: Call directly: Dr. Akshata Bhand — +91 8788198731. For assistance: Yash Bhand — +91 8262883668. You can also WhatsApp +91 8788198731.

livestock.q: Do you treat cattle, goats and other livestock?
livestock.a: Yes. Livestock care — including cattle, buffalo, goats and sheep — is part of the practice. This covers health check-ups, disease management, vaccination and artificial insemination.
